data.name: Mewracle Brew
data.detailed_description:
Escape to a world where the tea is warm, the whiskers are twitching, and a lifetime of herbal wisdom is at your fingertips. Welcome to Village Meow, a cozy cat village in need of a little comfort, a lot of healing, and a hero with four paws and a gentle soul.

Step into the paws of Smokey, a senior feline entrepreneur running the most popular Warung Jamu in the neighborhood. But life isn't all catnip and naps; the village chief, Bos Oyen, is a ruthless loan shark, and your debt is piling up.

  • Select The Ingredients: Step into your traditional pantry to hand-pick the perfect ingredients based on your customer’s needs.

  • Preparation Process: Prepare your ingredients at your own leisure with satisfying minigames.

    • Chop fresh herbs and roots to release their potent juices.

    • Crush dried leaves into a fine, aromatic powder using your mortar and pestle.

    • Dry fry the ingredients in a hot skillet to unlock deep, smoky undertones.

    • Boil your final blend in a bubbling clay pot, watching the water change hue as the magic infuses.

  • Adorn The Mix: Customize the visual flair of your drink.

    • Choose from a variety of glassware shapes.

    • Decorate it with beautiful garnishes like floating flower petals, a cinnamon stir-stick, or a slice of dried honey-fruit.

  • Customer Satisfaction: Serve your creation and watch your customer take their first sip. If you've listened well and brewed correctly, they will show their satisfaction, and they will gladly pay you to help clear the village debt. Plus, their bond with you will grow, unlocking deeper storylines!

One cup at a time, to brew enough money to save your home and mend the broken spirits of your fellow felines along the way.

  • Listen, Brew, and Heal: Villagers will stop by your Warung Jamu to complain about their ailments—from physical aches to emotional weights. Listen closely to their stories, and brew the perfect remedy.

  • A Village Worth Saving: Village meow is full of quirky, lovable cat residents. As you serve them the right blends, they’ll open up to you. Listen to their gossip, share in their joys, and build deep, lasting relationships that will give the village the strength to stand up to oppression.

Your success depends on your empathy.

data.short_description: Help Smokey the cat save his home! Run a traditional Warung Jamu in Village Meow, master ancient herbal recipes, and brew the perfect cure for your neighbors. Listen to their stories, cook with care, and earn enough to pay off the ruthless loan shark, Bos Oyen, before time runs out!
